Care · programme

Women to Women

Direct financial help to women in Ramallah and their families for basic needs and self-improvement. Projects are proposed in writing from Ramallah and approved by a committee.

Branch
Care · Destinations
Owning entity
Unconfirmed: the prototype says ARFHSN; afrp.org groups it under the Ramallah Foundation. Program Architecture asks which entity operates it.
Shape
Committee
Built in the Hub
Plan only

Who it's for

Members and non-members as donors and representatives; women in Ramallah as beneficiaries.

The operating year

Projects year-round; fundraising at the Mid-Year and Annual Conventions.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

The Women to Women Committee approves projects proposed in writing with a need justification and budget. What it escalates is not stated.

Money

Restricted gifts through a conduit; representatives give at least $100 a year (afrp.org). Whose books is unconfirmed.

Hand-offs

Destination on the Care branch, entered by choice. Sister programme to the Medical Mission; fundraises at the Convention.

What it needs

From the Federation's strategy
  • More projects (2025 SWOT)
  • Reach younger women (2025 SWOT)
  • A representative in each city (2025 SWOT)
From the platform
  • Only a page, charter and plan exist; giving goes through the funds path
  • Per-entity receipting for a conduit account needs the entity settled

Open questions

  • Which entity operates Women to Women: Ramallah Foundation, ARFECF, or AFRP?
